bullets.title: AAPL: Services decel + margin miss drive -4% pre-market; JPM and GS see buying opportunity
bullets.body: AAPL FQ4 beat on revenue (+12% y/y) and iPhone/Mac, but Dec Q guidance disappointed: Services growth guided to 8-9% (vs ~12% consensus), gross margin 45-46% vs 46.7% consensus, driven by unprecedented memory cost inflation and rising Siri AI inference costs. GS lowered PT to $380 (from $390); JPM webinar at 10:30am ET to discuss; Citi and MS both flagged FY27 EPS could be flat-to-down despite ~6-7% revenue growth as margin compression persists.

bullets.title: SHOP: -15% pre-market on GMV miss and light FCF guide; JPM calls pullback a buy
bullets.body: SHOP Q3 GMV +29% y/y missed ~+31% consensus; revenue +32% in-line; FCF margin 22% beat. Q4 revenue guided low-30s (above street) but Q4 FCF margin ~19.5% below JPMe/consensus of 23%/20.6% and gross profit guide high-20s was light. JPM maintains Overweight at ~$180 PT calling the pullback a buying opportunity; Mizuho also Outperform $180; UBS stays Neutral citing accelerating AI/infrastructure COGS (+$40M YoY).

bullets.title: PLTR: -6-8% despite 13th consecutive revenue acceleration; US Commercial TCV bookings slowdown spooked market
bullets.body: PLTR Q3 revenue +96% y/y (13th consecutive acceleration), EBIT margin ~61.7% (+1,100bps YoY), FY guidance raised ~5% above street. US Commercial revenue surpassed US Government for the first time ($3.94B run-rate, +148% y/y). However, US Commercial TCV bookings +11% (vs +153% prior quarter) and RPO/backlog flat sequentially due to shorter Sovereign AI contract durations. Piper raised to Overweight $235 PT; DA Davidson Buy; Karl Keirstead remains buyer.

bullets.title: MRVL acquires LITE in $115B all-stock deal; Jensen Huang approved deal pre-announcement
bullets.body: Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal valuing LITE at ~$1,132/share (24% premium to Oct 28), implying ~$115B EV. MRVL expects >$1B annual run-rate cost synergies and non-GAAP EPS accretion in year one; deal targets C2028 close. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang approved the deal before public announcement. MRVL downgraded to Hold/Neutral at TD Cowen (PT $350→$175) and BofA (PT $400→$225). CIEN -11% as a major LITE customer; COHR seen as beneficiary of optical asset scarcity.

bullets.title: NVDA: instructing DC partners to limit Chinese customer exposure to <49% of services
bullets.body: Nvidia ordering data center partners/clients to ensure majority (>51%) of services/sales go to non-Chinese companies, a new China-exposure restriction. Stock up ~1.8% in pre-market. Hedgeye flags NVDA as Bearish TRADE/TREND, down ~15% from ATH and in 'Quad4 Crash Mode.' SOX -21% month-over-month.

bullets.title: ON: AI Data Center disclosed at $180M in Q3 (+160% y/y); acquires Ferric for $600M; stock +2-3%
bullets.body: ON beat Q3 with revenue $1.72B (+7% QoQ) and EPS $0.90 vs $0.87 consensus; gross margin 41.2% (+184bps QoQ). AI Data Center revenue disclosed for first time at $180M, guiding to $620M for 2026 (+142% y/y) and ~$1.25B in 2027 (doubling again). Acquired Ferric Semiconductor for $600M + $175M contingent for AI power. Craig-Hallum upgraded to Buy ($85 PT); Citi cuts PT to $80 from $98 (13x C28 EPS) maintaining Neutral on multiple compression.

bullets.title: FN: 14th consecutive quarter of growth; revenue capacity doubling to ~$10B by Jan-27
bullets.body: Fabrinet (FN) beat and raised for the 14th straight quarter: Q1 EPS $4.34 vs FS $4.20, Q2 EPS guidance $4.77-4.92 vs FS $4.43. AWS TRx program moving from qualification to adoption; OCS and NPO framed as multi-hundred-million-dollar opportunities. Revenue capacity doubling from ~$5.8B to ~$10B by January 2027 with B11 facility breaking ground. Stock up ~11.5% post-earnings.

bullets.title: NET: JPMorgan upgrades to Overweight, $350 PT (+32% upside) on cybersecurity tailwinds
bullets.body: JPMorgan upgraded Cloudflare from Neutral to Overweight with a $350 price target (32% upside from $265), citing edge security/CDN structural advantage and PHP vulnerability tailwinds. Stock +2.3% pre-market. NET reports Thursday Nov 5 after close ($0.34 EPS est., $736.8M revenue est.).

bullets.title: AMD: earnings today after close; street expects $13.1B SepQ rev with Dec Q guide ~$17B
bullets.body: AMD reports tonight (5pm ET, $1.95 EPS est., $13.10B rev est.). MS and JPM checks suggest SepQ revenue at high-end of guidance (~$13.5B); DecQ guidance expected ~$16.5-17B (street ~$16.3B) driven by server CPU allocation from TSMC and strong Data Center. PC/Notebook channel seen stuffed; shorts picked up materially. AI GPU C27 revenue modeled at $42-48B on 14k racks.

bullets.title: ANET: checks suggest 5% revenue upside; deferred revenue +123% YoY signals hyperscaler demand
bullets.body: JPM chip desk notes ANET checks suggest ~5% upside to $3.315B estimate for tonight's print (4:30pm ET). Deferred revenue at $4.2B (+123% YoY) indicates strong hyperscaler commitment. UBS TMT notes ANET as a beat-check name. Sentiment score slightly bullish (+1).

bullets.title: SIRI: Goldman upgrades to Buy, PT $37 (+32%) on YouTube partnership and spectrum optionality
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs upgraded Sirius XM from Neutral to Buy, raising PT to $37 from $33 (32% total return). Key drivers: YouTube audio partnership modeled to contribute $1B revenue and $125M adjusted EBITDA by 2030; spectrum value rises to $12/share from $10; satellite capex decline expected to reduce leverage from 3.6x to 3.1x by 2028.

bullets.title: CRM: acquires Cresta for $2.7B to strengthen voice AI agent capabilities
bullets.body: Salesforce acquiring AI contact center startup Cresta for $2.7B to bolster voice agent capabilities. Enterprise IT survey (n=347) shows MSFT and ORCL best positioned for AI budget capture; AI-driven software reacceleration broadly deferred to 2028 as customers remain in ROI validation. SaaS multiples contracted 6.3% week-over-week.

bullets.title: ORCL raises $20B in equity + bonds for AI capex at $116/share
bullets.body: Oracle priced a secondary share offering at $116/share for 86.2M shares plus bond offerings totaling ~$20B in fresh capital for AI infrastructure investment. ORCL identified as well-positioned for AI infrastructure and efficiency spending in Financial Services and Manufacturing per enterprise IT survey.

bullets.title: BKNG: room night growth +5-6% in 3Q vs guide +3-5%; reports tonight at 4:30pm ET
bullets.body: MS TMT notes BKNG 3Q room night growth tracking +5-6% y/y vs the +3-5% guided range. Q4 guidance expected at +3-5%. Reports tonight (4:30pm ET, $4.49 EPS est., $9.55B rev est.).

bullets.title: CRWV: Hedgeye maintains #1 short; structural issues + AI sentiment decline; flash call 2pm ET
bullets.body: Hedgeye reiterates CRWV as its top short, citing AI sentiment deterioration, precarious GPU rental pricing, 15% unsecured debt, SpaceX competitive pressure, and questions about 2027 customer risk and Q3/Q4 active power additions. Flash call at 2pm ET to address 'analyst mischaracterizations.'

bullets.title: DIS: planning 20% cost cuts/layoffs across operations
bullets.body: Disney is asking managers to reduce costs by 20%, likely triggering thousands of layoffs across the company. No specific financial targets disclosed.

bullets.title: ROKU: beats 3Q EBITDA ($248.8M vs $160.6M est) but downgraded to Neutral at Rosenblatt ($160 PT, 3% upside)
bullets.body: Roku reported Q3 adjusted EBITDA of $248.8M, well above FactSet consensus of $160.6M, and revenue $1.50B vs $1.41B. Despite the beat, Rosenblatt downgraded to Neutral from Buy with a $160 PT implying only 3% upside from $155.52.

bullets.title: APP: vol spike to 95th percentile ahead of Nov 4 earnings; Citi sees scope for modest beat
bullets.body: AppLovin 1-month implied vol jumped 15.9 points to 95.5 (98th percentile) ahead of tomorrow's earnings. Citi sees scope for a modest beat given 3Q seasonality tailwinds and easy comps vs 2Q miss. Options positioning slightly bullish (put-call skew at 35th percentile).

bullets.title: ALAB: 3Q26 revenue ~$590M vs $550M guide; 4Q guides $700M vs $650M consensus
bullets.body: MS TMT notes Astera Labs tracking ~$590M in 3Q26 revenue vs $550M guidance, with 4Q guidance expected at ~$700M vs $650M consensus. No rating change flagged. Note: NVDA instructed ALAB and other partners to limit Chinese customer exposure.

bullets.title: EQIX: MS names as top data center pick; capacity projected to grow 136GW→316GW by 2030
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley identifies Equinix as its top pick in data centers as global AI capacity grows from 136 GW in 2026 to 316 GW by 2030 (~20% CAGR). Scale and infrastructure position cited as key advantages; inflation and financing cited as constraints but do not impede the growth trajectory.
